book.name: Wer Mamit
book.title: Wer Mamit Moloyo Wende Moko Duto

content.text: Mano kaka ijaber, jaherana!
Yaye, mano kaka ijaber!
Wengeni neno mamuol ka akuru.
Yie wiyi chalo gi kweth mag diek,
malor koa e Got Gilead.
Lekeni tar mana ka kweth mag rombe makoro eka oliel yiegi
kendo mowuok kar luok.
Moro ka moro wuotho gi nyithinde ma rude,
kendo onge moro man kende.
Pien dhogi chalo gi law marakwaro;
kendo dhogi ber ahinya.
Lembi moum gi law
yom machalo mana gi olemo mongʼinore.
Ngʼuti chalo gi osuch Daudi,
mochungʼ tir gi chia;
kuode alufu achiel oliero kuome,
ma kargi duto gin kuodi mag jokedo.
Thundeni chalo gi nyithi mwanda ariyo maromre
adier gichalo gi nyithind mwanda ma rude,
makwayo e kind ondanyo.
Ka piny oseyawore
kendo rumbi oserumo,
eka abiro dhi ewi got kuma gik madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar yudoree
kendo nyaka ewi gode matindo miwangʼoe ubani.
Ijaber e yore duto, jaherana;
onge mbala moro amora e dendi.
Yaye jaherana, bi wadhi kodi ka waa e got Lebanon,
adier bi koda walor ka waa Lebanon.
Lor piny ia e chuny got Amana,
lor ia ewi got mar Senir gi Hermon,
wuog e bur sibuoche
kendo wuog ewi got kama kwach oloko miechgi.
Yaye jaherana,
ka aneno kaka ingʼiya,
kod tigo malich miliero
e ngʼuti, to chunya rumo.
Mano kaka herani miya mor, yaye osiepna, ma ahero;
mano kaka herani kelo mor mangʼeny moloyo divai,
kendo ngʼwe ngʼar moloyo modhi mamoko duto!
Yaye jaherana, pien dhogi mit ka mor kich;
lewi chalona chak kata mor kich.
Lewni mirwako dungʼ tik mamit mana ka tik mamit mar got Lebanon.
Yaye jaherana, ichalo gi puodho mochiel;
kendo ka soko molor dhoge modin motegno.
Yiende madongo e puothi gin olembe mongʼinore,
molembegi beyo,
kendo mit kaka olemb hena kod nad.
Gin olembe mopogore opogore kaka nad kod safron,
gi kalmas kod sinamon,
kod yedhe mangʼwe ngʼar,
kaka ubani gi mane-mane,
kod apilo mamit mag tedo.
Ichalo gi puodho ma thidhna ni e iye,
bende ichalo gi soko mar pi mamol,
kendo ichalo gi aore mamol kawuok ewi gode mag Lebanon.
Wuogi ka ikudho, in yamb nyandwat,
bende in yamb milambo kudhi!
Kudhi e puotha,
mondo tikne okere malach.
We jaherana koro obi odonji e puothe
kendo obil olembene moyiedhi kendo mamit.
